balloons.text: Two mornings later. Ninth round complete.
Give Kiva my morning.
Daro brought the packing stock up. His cart is below.
DaroI would rather earn something on the way back.
KivaThis set is Rusk’s. The buyer’s is still in the jig.
I thought I was taking it to Rusk.
KivaYou are collecting it for me. We have not agreed the rest yet.
Rusk asked for the rear yard today. His long frame is in the front aisle.
DaroYou bring the box to the landing. I take the cart leg; her board comes back with you.
DaroThe cart cannot climb these steps. From that landing, the ramp goes round to his yard.
Aren collects. Daro may carry it from the landing to Rusk.
KivaIf he cannot receive it, bring it back. No doorstep drop.
My usual cart share, when Rusk’s receipt comes back.
KivaThe rest of the collection fee is yours, Aren. Agreed?
ArenAgreed.
KivaHis slip comes back. The hinges stay with him.
One box to Rusk. The board back here.
Use the outside turn. The inside catches the board.
Here. No tilt over the wheel.
It is yours to carry now.
DaroTo Rusk. Or back to Kiva.
I could come down with you.
You can. It will still be my load.
I will take this back.
Rusk. Kiva’s set.
Put it here, out of the shavings.
Good. I can fit these when the frame is out.
Tell her I have the set.
That is the piece I was waiting for.
I keep thinking I should be there.
You brought this back. I can keep working.
KivaLet him finish his part.
Later, in his own room.
How was the collection?
I only carried it halfway.
SeraDid it arrive?
ArenYes.
Will you walk to the east washhouse with us after tomorrow’s round?
SeraYes. With the person handing the goods over.
